question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf1630d906bff3e60569e11a5ece302e23933c461e5d78771e08e5dd0b46adb5.png]
solution:
**The logic followed here is :**

The circle inside the box is flipping in every next figure towards right and the triangle is shifting anti-clockwise to the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/deb8220fd6ef08931a427ed776450a8290a0e5e859c207b21c5f765ad604bb74.png] 

∴ Figure in Option 1 will replace the (?) mark.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
